title: Purple Warrior Poses
description: Two full-body poses of the same dark-skinned female warrior with short silver hair are displayed side by side against a solid black background. She wears a revealing purple and white tribal outfit with leaf-like armor pieces, white wraps on her forearms, and purple leg wraps, holding distinct combat stances with glowing purple energy effects around her hands and body.
prompt: A powerful dark-skinned female warrior with short silver-white hair, wearing ornate purple and white leaf-patterned tribal armor, white forearm wraps, and purple ankle wraps.
